sources.fullCitation: Wikipedia contributors. “My Song for You (film).” Wikipedia, The Free Encyclopedia. Gives a 1934 British musical film directed by Maurice Elvey for Gaumont British and Ciné-Alliance, produced by Michael Balcon and Arnold Pressburger, starring Jan Kiepura, Sonnie Hale and Emlyn Williams, adapted from Ernst Marischka and Irma von Cube’s Ein Lied für Dich, with a score by Mischa Spoliansky and the title song by Spoliansky and Frank Eyton.

works.title: My Song for You
works.publicNote: English-language version of Ein Lied für Dich, made in Britain by Gaumont British with Jan Kiepura in the leading role. No document of the time credits Bronisław Kaper: The Box Office Check-Up of 1935 lists the film’s songs as Mischa Spoliansky and Frank Eyton’s “My Song for You” and “With All My Heart”, with pieces by Verdi and Schubert. Sieghardt’s catalogue names Spoliansky, Kaper and Jurmann for its music and says “Ninon”, from the German original, was sung in it in English; the English “Ninon” registered in 1933 is from A Song for You, the British title of Ein Lied für Dich.
